ios.desc:
Get realtime BART departures for nearby stations just by opening the app. Made by BART commuters, for BART commuters. 

- Instantly see all departures from nearby stations.
- Get the distance to each station, how long it will take to get there, and whether your can make a departure. 
- Save your home and work stations to automatically show trains to your destination, and your arrival time, as soon as you open the app. 


shouldIRunSF@gmail.com

quotes.text:
I made a (free and ad free) app for BART that tells you if you need to run to catch your train or not. Instantly upon opening the app, without needing to tap anything, it automatically figures out which train you want and helps you hurry, just a little bit, to make the next one rather than wait.

Feedback appreciated!

https://apps.apple.com/us/app/should-i-run/id933717076
